title: Luisa independent review record
description: Output of the independent reviewer role (docs/agentic/RELEASE-RUNBOOK.md, step 5). scripts/land.py refuses to land without a valid record whose head is the PR head and whose verdict is ship.

head.description: Full SHA of the reviewed PR head.

base.description: Full SHA of the base (main) the PR was reviewed against.

resolution.description: Filled by the implementer: fixed in <sha>, or why no change.

review.description: What was checked and how, by every reviewer and round.

reviewers.description: Neutral role names, e.g. 'reviewer A (papers)'; never personal data.
